info.title: SiteSentinel API
info.summary: Portfolio website monitoring, audit and reporting backend
info.description: Source-of-truth OpenAPI reference for the implemented Flask routes. All personal monitor/report routes refer only to the logged-in user's personal workspace. Team routes require membership and enforce role permissions. The check success percentage is a sample-based metric, **not** a duration-weighted uptime SLA. Static audits do not execute JavaScript. This is a portfolio project, not a production-hardened public SaaS.
